root_text:
What are the symptoms of HMPV?
As per Cleveland Clinic, symptoms of human metapneumovirus include:

Cough.
Fever.
Runny or stuffy nose.
Sore throat.
Wheezing.
Shortness of breath (dyspnea).
Rash.
